Independently regenerated all 77,? flags by dimension (2619,21546,41580,22680), orbit cells (293,2394,4620,2520), all signed cellular boundaries, verified d^2=0 and exact integral unimodular unit-pivot Smith residuals: d1 1^292; d2 1^2101,3; d3 1^2511,3. Ranks imply H0=Z,H1=Z/3,H2=Z^6+Z/3,H3=Z^8; matching complex M9 is simply connected via standard connectivity bound; nonidentity rotations with fixed geometric points generate exactly <r^3>, and Armstrong gives pi1=C9/<r^3>=C3. Entire finite flag complex checked independently, not extrapolated to larger n.
